EmailTemplate.name: Sustainability PhD Application Complete
EmailTemplate.subject: PhD Application Complete
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
I am writing to update you on the status of your application to the PhD program in the School of Sustainability at Arizona State University for the fall 2015 semester.
Your application is complete and will be reviewed in January. We will let you know the decision in early February.
Save the Dates: March 5-7 We will hold a recruitment event on Friday, March 6, 2015. This event is open to all admitted applicants and is designed to showcase what the ASU School of Sustainability has to offer and provides an opportunity for admitted students to meet our faculty, our current students, alumni and other students considering our program.
If admitted, we will send you complete details about the recruitment event logistics and potential travel support in early February. Please add this event to your calendar now if you plan to visit ASU and the School of Sustainability.
If you are unable to attend the March 6 recruitment event, you can still visit us at any time of year, but we do ask that you schedule appointments with faculty before you arrive.
Please contact the Sustainability advising office at 480-727-6963 or SOSGradAdvising@asu.edu if you have any questions.
Regards,
Katerina Kinast Graduate Academic Success Coordinator ASU School of Sustainability Katie.Kinast@asu.edu
